checklist: Confirm core user flows and explicitly scope out secondary features.
Pin down Non-Functional Requirements: scale (DAU/QPS), p99 latency budget, availability target (e.g., 99.9% vs 99.999%), consistency model (strong vs eventual), and data retention.
interviewDeliveryFramework.antiPattern: Jumping straight into drawing boxes without knowing whether the system is read-heavy, write-heavy, or consistency-critical.

checklist: Convert DAU × actions/day ÷ 10^5 seconds/day into Average QPS.
Estimate read/write QPS split, ingress/egress bandwidth, and 5-year storage footprint.
interviewDeliveryFramework.antiPattern: Calculating arbitrary 6-digit numbers with fake precision instead of driving design decisions from orders of magnitude.

checklist: Name primary entities and access patterns before picking a database engine.
Define clean REST, gRPC, WebSocket, or SSE endpoints including pagination cursors and idempotency keys.
interviewDeliveryFramework.antiPattern: Designing normalized SQL tables before verifying query patterns or sharding keys.

checklist: Trace the end-to-end write path and read path across Client, Edge/CDN, LB/Gateway, Services, Cache, and Storage.
Explain how every arrow carries synchronous vs asynchronous calls.
interviewDeliveryFramework.antiPattern: Drawing disconnected components without walking through request/response lifecycles.

checklist: Stress-test the design at 10x–100x load: find single points of failure, hot partitions, cache stampedes, and connection limits.
Justify concrete trade-offs (e.g., fan-out on write vs read, Raft vs eventual quorum, Kafka vs SQS).
interviewDeliveryFramework.antiPattern: Naming buzzwords ('just add Kafka/Redis') without explaining partitioning, failure recovery, or backpressure.

checklist: Cover observability (RED metrics, distributed tracing, p99 alerts), graceful degradation, multi-region failover, and cost levers.
interviewDeliveryFramework.antiPattern: Leaving out monitoring, rollback, or cost implications at Senior/Staff levels.

bar: Drives a coherent end-to-end architecture covering functional requirements.
Applies basic caching, load balancing, and SQL vs NoSQL distinctions accurately.
Completes basic QPS and storage math cleanly.
Proactively identifies NFRs and leads the conversation without interviewer prompting.
Diagnoses scaling bottlenecks (hot keys, stampedes, replication lag, async decoupling).
Explicitly compares architectural alternatives with concrete trade-offs.
Demonstrates deep storage/consensus intuition (LSM vs B-Tree, Raft/fencing, multi-region consistency).
Designs for operational realism: graceful degradation, blast radius containment, cost-to-serve (including GPU/VRAM & token economics for AI), and incremental migration.

estimationFormulas.name: Average QPS
estimationFormulas.notes: Uses 10^5 seconds/day (86,400 rounded) for rapid mental math.

estimationFormulas.name: Peak QPS
estimationFormulas.notes: Use 2x–3x for smooth global traffic; 5x+ for regional commute spikes or flash sales.

estimationFormulas.name: Network Bandwidth (Bytes/sec)
estimationFormulas.notes: Multiply Bytes/sec by 8 to compare against NIC/link capacity in Mbps or Gbps.

estimationFormulas.name: Multi-Year Storage Footprint
estimationFormulas.notes: Account for replication factor (typically 3x) and index overhead (1.2x–1.5x).

estimationFormulas.name: 80/20 Hot Cache RAM Sizing
estimationFormulas.notes: Cache top 20% hot items responsible for ~80% of read volume.

genaiSizingMetrics.levers: Semantic cache, prompt prefix caching, smaller router/SLM, lower prefill queue depth.

genaiSizingMetrics.metric: TPS / ITL (Tokens Per Second / Inter-Token Latency)
genaiSizingMetrics.levers: Continuous batching, speculative decoding, tensor parallelism, FP8/INT8 quantization.

genaiSizingMetrics.target: Must fit concurrent sequence contexts inside HBM without OOM preemption
genaiSizingMetrics.levers: PagedAttention block sharing, GQA/MQA attention, sliding-window or context compaction.

genaiSizingMetrics.target: Dual-bucket rate limiting (Request Count + Token Budget)
genaiSizingMetrics.levers: Estimated prompt tokens reserved upfront, reconciled with actual completion tokens on stream close.
